cert/users.mjs (9.12.0-5, H1 homescoop#207, slicc-kernel >= 1.44.0): as root id = 'uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)', id -un/whoami/logname root, id -G 0, groups root, groups cone 'cone : cone users'; as kernel.users.add({name:'cone'}) id = 'uid=1000(cone) gid=1000(cone) groups=1000(cone),100(users)', id -G '1000 100', whoami/logname cone; a file cone creates in ~ shows 'cone cone' in ls -l and stat %U:%G. Needs shims/slicc (process credentials, setgrent/getgrent) and build-gnu-cli.sh linking slicc_pwd's --wrap and ac_cv_func_getgroups_works=yes. File owners are the kernel's (1.44.0: uid 1000 for every file), so root's files are not checked

rdev (9.12.0-6, scripts/emsdk-patches/statx-rdev.patch, homescoop#324): stat -c '%t:%T' on /dev/null, /dev/zero, /dev/full and /dev/tty gives the kernel's 1:3, 1:5, 1:7, 5:0; ls -l /dev/null shows '1, 3' on each of 3 runs; a regular file is 0:0. 9.12.0-5: /dev/null 0:0, ls -l majors from uninitialised stack

glue-mode (9.12.0-6, scripts/command-modes.mjs): bin/coreutils (the Emscripten glue) and bin/coreutils.wasm are 0755, as installed with the tarball's modes (the harness's kernel.chmod); run by path as kernel user cone under users enforce, bin/coreutils --version prints coreutils (GNU coreutils) 9.12. 9.12.0-5 shipped the glue 0644: 'Permission denied', rc 126

linkat (9.12.0-6, slicc_libc_gaps.c + slicc-linkat.js, slicc-kernel#563): coreutils.wasm imports env.__syscall_linkat; on the cert kernel (1.100.4, the wrapper since 1.90.0, slicc-kernel#568) ln, ln -f and cp -l in a tmpfs mount make real hard links (the files share the inode, nlink 2), the OPFS root is EMLINK and tmpfs → root EXDEV; on a kernel without the wrapper (1.88.0, see extra_kernels) they are 'Too many links' (EMLINK) as before. 9.12.0-5: no import (libc's weak stub answered EMLINK inside the wasm, so no kernel could link)

cert/uname.mjs (9.12.0-7, shims/slicc __syscall_uname, homescoop#373 / slicc-kernel#625; homescoop#358 prefix map; homescoop#425): coreutils.wasm imports env.__syscall_uname and names no emsdk cache directory (its emsdk paths are /emsdk/...). On a kernel that answers the import (slicc-kernel >= 1.98.0, read from /proc/version; the cert kernel 1.100.4): uname -s is Linux = /proc/sys/kernel/ostype, -r = /proc/sys/kernel/osrelease = /proc/version's release, -v = /proc/version's version (#1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC), -n = hostname (and /proc/sys/kernel/hostname when the kernel has it; 1.100.4 doesn't), -m wasm32, -o Emscripten (coreutils' configure-time host OS, not a utsname field), and uname -a is exactly those six joined by spaces, printable ASCII only (every field NUL-terminated within its 65 bytes). A kernel >= 1.98.0 on which uname -s is not Linux fails. On an older kernel: exactly Emscripten 4.0.23 #1 wasm32, as before. 9.12.0-6: no import, /home/runner/.cache/emsdk/0.4.0 paths; on 1.100.4 its uname -s is Emscripten (NEGATIVE.md)
